stages.boundary: entry synchronize completes before the timer starts; completion synchronize is inside elapsed time
stages.interpretation: Broad/detail cuts each assign every scope's exclusive time exactly once. They are alternative cuts, not additive tables. Selected inclusive subtree views overlap parent scopes and each other; do not add them to either cut. Canonical request_call merges call IDs only. Entry waits for prior work can remain in an enclosing exclusive row; remainders are not pure Python overhead.
stages.retention: all broad/detail/mechanism cuts and selected inclusive views; canonical call paths omitted; alternative cuts are not additive

operators.boundary: entry synchronize completes before the operator timer starts; dispatch and completion synchronize are timed; descriptor collection and aggregation are excluded
operators.elapsed_boundary: training elapsed includes observer and scalar return; inference elapsed additionally includes hashes/checks/JSON IO. Neither is normal timing.
operators.interpretation: Every dispatch row belongs to one phase/module/category. These are alternative partitions of one operator pass, never added to stages or normal timing. Floating index/gather within NodeLinear/HeadQuery/NodeVector/fused projection scope is called parameter indexing; other indexing remains data indexing. Ordinary backward has no mathematical owner labels except observed recomputation scopes. Matrix metadata is actual operands; dense MAdds only cover recognizable forward contractions, not opaque native attention, backward or complete FLOPs. Repeated logical output bytes are not bus traffic, unique allocation or peak memory; in-place destinations may be counted repeatedly.

Selected inclusive subtree views overlap parent scopes and each other; do not add them to either cut. Canonical request_call merges call IDs only. Entry waits for prior work can remain in an enclosing exclusive row; remainders are not pure Python overhead.
stages.retention: all broad/detail/mechanism cuts and selected inclusive views; canonical call paths omitted; alternative cuts are not additive

operators.boundary: entry synchronize completes before the operator timer starts; dispatch and completion synchronize are timed; descriptor collection and aggregation are excluded
operators.elapsed_boundary: training elapsed includes observer and scalar return; inference elapsed additionally includes hashes/checks/JSON IO. Neither is normal timing.
operators.interpretation: Every dispatch row belongs to one phase/module/category. These are alternative partitions of one operator pass, never added to stages or normal timing. Floating index/gather within NodeLinear/HeadQuery/NodeVector/fused projection scope is called parameter indexing; other indexing remains data indexing. Ordinary backward has no mathematical owner labels except observed recomputation scopes. Matrix metadata is actual operands; dense MAdds only cover recognizable forward contractions, not opaque native attention, backward or complete FLOPs. Repeated logical output bytes are not bus traffic, unique allocation or peak memory; in-place destinations may be counted repeatedly.

top_operator_shape_groups.selection: largest recorded seconds, descending; remaining groups stay in the fingerprinted cost review

top_matrix_and_attention_shape_groups.selection: largest recorded seconds, descending; remaining groups stay in the fingerprinted cost review

packed_query_work.definition: Selected rows from actual Queries.publish index_put index/value lengths; executed rows from one independent FFN down contraction per pack; prepare rows from KV kv or SSD input projection operands. Tensor-rectangle padding only, not hidden backend tile padding. All derive from this operator pass; not semantic history capacity or an activity trajectory for normal samples.

repeated_logical_output_bytes.definition: sum of the cost review's repeated logical output bytes; not bus traffic, unique allocation, live memory, or peak memory

operators.retention: phase/category/module sums and top operators retained; bounded top20 shape groups; packed query totals retain padding and preparation counts, omitting full shape-group lists

review.normal_retention: all warmup/normal updates retain scalar loss, finite flags, timings and state metadata; only the first normal update retains complete aggregate SHAs of joined readout, parameters, gradients, AdamW and private state; actual CPU snapshots were compared in-process but not saved as durable payload; per-call raw Tide values/strengths and input gradients are not qualification fields here
review.restoration_scope: in-process CPU anchor restore of warmed model, AdamW slots, parameter gradients, RNG and detached private continuation; a genuine following update is compared; this is not a disk checkpoint roundtrip
review.numerical_scope: same mathematical candidate and warmed trajectory with and without intrusive hooks; original atol=1e-6, rtol=2e-3 retained; finite nonexactness is reported without assigning a rounding cause; does not supersede older candidate qualification failures
review.localization_limit: Exact retained forward readout/private state with nonexact parameter gradients locates the first retained difference at gradients, not at a particular backward operator: intermediate forward activations and per-operator VJPs were not retained, so this does not establish the cause.

observation.boundary: entry synchronize completes before the timer starts; completion synchronize is inside elapsed time
observation.interpretation: separate intrusive stage pass; inclusive rows overlap and must not be summed; exclusive rows partition only this observation, not normal wall time or kernel time; a nested entry wait for prior unwrapped work stays in its parent; Python, synchronization and hook overhead perturb execution

observation.boundary: entry synchronize completes before the operator timer starts; dispatch and completion synchronize are timed; descriptor collection and aggregation are excluded
observation.interpretation: separate intrusive operator pass on the selected device; rows group tensor shapes, strides, dtypes and devices, not scalar argument values; totals include completed dispatches only and exclude Python gaps, descriptor bookkeeping and entry waits; summed seconds are neither normal wall time nor hardware kernel time; dispatcher operations can contain multiple native kernels or no device kernel
observation.limits: metadata is from intercepted dispatcher tensors on this one replay; a call can contain several native kernels or no device kernel; dtype presence is not a native-kernel precision proof; scalar argument values are not grouping keys

qualification_authority.authority: read-only review of frozen raw records; no production source or raw artifact mutation; no device workload launched; resource/process-tree terminal verification belongs to the parent
limits: Different Tide and Transformer functions are not numerically compared to each other.
Stage/operator passes synchronize and perturb scheduling; their durations are not normal wall shares or native kernel times.
Entry waits are excluded from the entering stage/operator; nested pre-entry work remains in the parent's exclusive time.
Only completed worker comparisons are reviewed; durable tensor payload is unavailable for independent value recomputation.
This evidence does not replace independent local formulas/VJPs, whole-candidate qualification or older preserved FP32/BF16 failures.
Medium training is d192/KV32 ratio representative, not d768/KV128 or 9B training qualification.
The fixed32 Transformer is an auxiliary different-function reference; not an A-D joint match or model-quality comparison.
Artifact suffix tf32 denotes the 32-layer Transformer, not TensorFloat-32 arithmetic; the requested precision is FP32.

units.throughput: independent input positions/s; whole request sequences/s separately labelled

boundaries: Normal, stages and operators are three different observations. Never add their times or convert intrusive stage/operator fractions into normal wall-time shares.
Inference uses the9B graph and a fixed32-layer8.778B reference; training uses the129M d192/KV32 representative and a separate32-layer near-total shape.

Inference first-output availability is populated after a separate diagnostic support witness; before that completes first-output latency remains unknown, even if normal throughput samples are already complete.
Normal inference stable decode excludes its first incremental call (15 calls); diagnostic decode includes all16. The normal full-decode fields retain the matching16-call boundary.
No task head, token sampler or quality evaluation; first backbone output is not full language-model TTFT.
Normal training legacy backward can include pending loss/concatenation; diagnostic loss/backward have distinct synchronized boundaries.

Training diagnostics compare the first real normal update after restoring parameters/gradients/AdamW/RNG/private state. completed_finite is execution status: numerical_state and threshold/support details must also be read.
Raw identities retain source, physical device, initial parameters, actual input shapes and hashes; full input hashes differ across widths while paired feature prefixes should match.
Parent owns resource admission and terminal process/cgroup verification. This script does not call systemctl, devices or experiment launchers.
No source/raw mutation or new experiment; each raw fingerprint identifies exactly the bytes parsed in this snapshot.
Stage and operator passes independently replay; their seconds must never be added, or divided by normal latency as wall-time shares.
Stage timing includes completion synchronization and hook/host overhead. Entry waits before a child timer can remain in its parent's exclusive time.
Operator seconds include dispatch and completion waits but exclude entry waits and descriptor bookkeeping; they are not native hardware kernel time.
Training normal backward seconds include concatenation/loss; separate stage loss/backward are the only isolated loss/backward measurements.
Medium training uses d192/KV32 versus a new 32-layer near-total constructor; this is not 9B training. Inference uses d768/KV128 versus fixed d4352/FFN15208/32-layer reference.
Normal samples are finite engineering observations, not task-quality equivalence. Same-candidate diagnostic output/state/update qualifications remain separate.
Autograd backward operators without forward module scopes retain unknown mathematical ownership; shapes alone do not establish FFN attribution.
This compact export validates record identity and arithmetic only. The parent release audit owns actual service/cgroup/descendant terminal verification.
All five normal scalar samples are retained. Diagnostic call trees, canonical stage trees, complete packed shape lists and most matrix shape groups remain in fingerprinted inputs.
Stage broad/detail/mechanism cuts are alternative nonoverlapping partitions; selected inclusive subtrees overlap parents. Operator shape top20 is a bounded view, not all execution work.
The summaries retain finite nonexact training comparisons and original thresholds. No tolerance was widened and no difference is attributed to rounding by this exporter.
Inference private floating history and all SSD convolution-clock values are not fully witnessed by metadata/output identity replay; consult each qualification state_scope.
No global best-batch, 9B training, A-D matching, full-language-model TTFT, or model-quality conclusion is added by these four points.
